purpose: Teach: インストラクター/障壁/離職/測量/バリアフリー/粉飾/生計/ステータス

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、IT インストラクターを内製化しましょう
lines.en: Let's bring our IT instructor training in-house.
lines.style: Decisive, direct opening. Measured pace. Professional authority without harshness. Voice steady and forward-moving.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外進出の障壁を整理しました
lines.en: Yes. I've organized the barriers we'll need to address for overseas expansion.
lines.style: Affirmative and attentive. Slight nod in the voice. Competent, efficient delivery. No hesitation—ready to move forward.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 離職を防ぐ社内アンケートを取りましょう
lines.en: Let's run an internal survey to prevent employee turnover.
lines.style: Directive but collaborative. Steady eye contact level. Thoughtful pacing—this matters. Clear expectation without demanding tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新店舗の測量結果を共有します
lines.en: Yes. I'll share the survey results from the new location.
lines.style: Confirmation with follow-through. Warm professional tone. Slight emphasis on 'I'll'—taking ownership. Crisp delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内をバリアフリー化する計画を進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with making our office fully accessible.
lines.style: Measured direction. Slight warmth underneath—this is about people. Steady pace. Voice carries both conviction and care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。粉飾の疑いがないか内部監査を行います
lines.en: Yes. I'll conduct an internal audit to make sure there are no accounting irregularities.
lines.style: Professional assurance. Careful precision on the critical word. Thorough and trustworthy tone. Not rushed—exactness matters.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員の生計向上を支援する制度を整えましょう
lines.en: Let's establish systems to support our employees' financial wellbeing.
lines.style: Directive with genuine care. Slower, more deliberate than the first proposal. Weight on 'support'—this is not just policy. Sincere.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社のブランドステータスを伸ばします
lines.en: Yes. I'll strengthen our brand position in the market.
lines.style: Affirmative close. Confident and forward-looking. Slight lift at the end—optimistic momentum. Crisp professional finish.
